import sys,random,json,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from service import Controller
from compiler_proto import validate_plan
random.seed(123)
for case in range(300):
 n=random.randint(2,14)
 # generate random links
 links=[]
 for u in range(n):
  for v in range(u+1,n):
   if random.random()<0.3:links.append((u,v))
 # capacities random high to make many feasible
 caps=[random.choice([10,30,100,1000,10**6]) for _ in links]
 # bookings none or one small
 bookings=[]
 if links and random.random()<0.5:
  li=random.randrange(len(links)); rate=random.randint(1,max(1,caps[li]//5))
  s=random.randint(0,10);e=s+random.randint(1,20)
  bookings.append({'id':'L0','owner':'own','window':[s,e],'envelope':[[li,rate]]})
 load={'op':'load','n':n,'links':[[u,v,c] for (u,v),c in zip(links,caps)],'bookings':bookings}
 ctl=Controller(); r=ctl.handle(load); assert r['status']=='ok',r
 R=0;T=0
 prep_payloads={}
 made=0
 for step in range(100):
  op=random.choice(['edit','advance','prepare','commit','cancel','audit'])
  if op=='advance':
   t=random.randint(T,min(30,T+5))
   req={'op':'advance','time':t};resp=ctl.handle(req)
   if resp['status']=='ok':T=resp['now'];R=resp['rev']
  elif op=='audit':
   at=[random.randint(T,min(30,T+5)) for _ in range(random.randint(0,4))]
   req={'op':'audit','at':at};resp=ctl.handle(req)
  elif op=='edit':
   k=min(len(links),random.randint(0,4)); ids=random.sample(range(len(links)),k) if links else []
   changes=[]
   for l in ids:
    c=random.choice([0,max(0,caps[l]-10),caps[l],caps[l]+10,random.randint(0,10**6)])
    changes.append([l,c])
   force=random.choice([False,True])
   req={'op':'edit','rev':R,'changes':changes,'force':force};resp=ctl.handle(req)
   if resp['status']=='ok':
    R=resp['rev']
    for l,c in changes:caps[l]=c
  elif op=='prepare':
   if made>=2: continue
   # choose two+ participants
   np=random.randint(2,min(6,n)) # supports n small
   C=random.sample(range(n),np)
   roots={v:random.choice([0,1,2,5,10,100]) for v in C}
   if sum(roots.values())==0:roots[C[0]]=1
   denv=[];useids=random.sample(range(len(links)),random.randint(0,min(4,len(links)))) if links else []
   for l in useids:denv.append([l,random.choice([1,2,5,10,100])])
   p=random.choice([1,2,5]);s=random.randint(T,min(30,T+5));e=s+p*random.randint(1,4)
   bid='P'+str(made);own='own'
   req={'op':'prepare','id':bid,'owner':own,'window':[s,e],'period':p,
        'participants':[[v,roots[v]] for v in C],'envelope':denv,'rev':R}
   resp=ctl.handle(req)
   if resp['status'] in ('prepared','denied'):
    prep_payloads[bid]=req;made+=1
   if resp['status']=='prepared':
    # validate plan
    try:
     validate_plan(resp['plan'],n,links,sorted(roots),roots,p,dict(denv))
    except Exception as ex:
     print('PLAN FAIL case',case,'step',step,'req',req,'load',load,'resp',resp,repr(ex));raise
   elif resp['status']=='denied':
    if resp['kind']=='capacity':
     l=resp['link'];t=resp['time'];used=sum((b for b in []),0)
     # compute used from controller live at t
     u=ctl._used_at(l,t)+dict(denv).get(l,0)
     assert s<=t<e and u==resp['used'] and u>resp['capacity'] and resp['capacity']==ctl.caps[l],(req,resp,u)
    else:
     S=set(resp['cut']);P=set(roots)
     cap=sum(p*dict(denv).get(i,0) for i,(u,v) in enumerate(links) if (u in S)!=(v in S))
     rr=sum(roots[v] for v in P if v in S)
     assert 0< rr and P-S and cap<rr,(req,resp,cap,rr)
   elif resp['status'] not in ('error',):
    print('unexpected prepare',resp);raise SystemExit
  elif op=='commit':
   ids=list(prep_payloads)+(['L0'] if bookings else [])
   if not ids:continue
   bid=random.choice(ids);own='own' if bid!='L0' else 'own'
   req={'op':'commit','id':bid,'owner':own,'rev':random.choice([R,random.randint(0,10)])}
   resp=ctl.handle(req)
   if resp.get('replay') is False and resp['status']=='ok':R=resp['rev']
  elif op=='cancel':
   ids=list(prep_payloads)+(['L0'] if bookings else [])
   if not ids:continue
   bid=random.choice(ids)
   req={'op':'cancel','id':bid,'owner':'own','rev':R};resp=ctl.handle(req)
   if resp['status']=='ok':R=resp['rev']
 # final audit
 resp=ctl.handle({'op':'audit','at':[T]})
 assert resp['status']=='ok'
print('FUZZ OK')
